custody: Bibliographic verification and short host paraphrases. Full publisher/arXiv bytes are not archived or hash-pinned here.

sources.name: Hardy 2001
sources.observed_scope: Continuous reversible connectivity is a declared axiom within a larger reconstruction package.

sources.name: Masanes-Muller 2011
sources.observed_scope: Reversible transitivity is assumed; the authors explicitly do not impose continuity. Local tomography is another requirement.

sources.name: Soler theorem exposition by Holland 1995
sources.observed_scope: An infinite orthonormal sequence in an orthomodular form is an essential stated hypothesis for the classical Hilbert-field conclusion.

sources.name: Schumacher-Westmoreland modal QM
sources.observed_scope: Finite-field model uses modal possibility rather than probabilities; the full paper explicitly lacks a natural inner product and vector orthogonality.

sources.name: Giles-Selinger exact synthesis
sources.observed_scope: Exact ring characterization specifies local ancillas and separately characterizes the ancilla-free case.

sources.name: Barnum-Wilce local tomography
sources.observed_scope: Complex reconstruction is conditional on Jordan structure, composite constraints, local tomography and an available qubit.

sources.name: Stueckelberg 1960
sources.location: Original article, Quantum Theory in Real Hilbert Space
sources.observed_scope: Introduces a commuting complex-structure operator J within the specified real-Hilbert/relativistic uncertainty framework.

sources.name: Renou et al. 2021
sources.observed_scope: Network separation is stated for a Hilbert/composition model that represents independent preparations by product states.

sources.name: Wu et al. experiment
sources.observed_scope: Reports a network test under stated source/locality assumptions; not an assumption-free exclusion of every real representation.

sources.name: Hoffreumon-Woods March 2026
sources.observed_scope: Distinguishes product-state independence from operational independence and claims real simulations of complex finite protocols under the latter.

sources.name: Hoffreumon-Woods October clarification
sources.observed_scope: Challenges unrestricted experimental-falsification claims on source-independence grounds; recorded as an assumption-sensitive account rather than settled consensus.
